sentences.en: Many ethnic groups traditionally give money as a wedding gift.
sentences.zh: 许多民族的传统是婚礼时赠送金钱。

sentences.en: Writings by ethnic minorities begin to reach a critical mass.
sentences.zh: 少数民族的作品开始达到一定的数量。

sentences.en: They hate certain ethnic groups; I hate all ethnic groups.
sentences.zh: 他们憎恨某些种族群体；我则对所有种族群体都感到厌恶。

senses.zh: 种族的，部落的；某文化群体的
